##### Project General Facts

Padel Living Residences is a contemporary residential development in Jeddah, positioned as a vibrant and highly connected urban address on King Abdulaziz Road. Designed as part of a large-scale master community, the project brings together residential, commercial, and lifestyle elements in one integrated environment. It offers a modern collection of apartments, 1-, 2-, 3- and 4-bedroom units, crafted for those who seek an active, social, and city-centric way of living.

The project is built around a dynamic lifestyle concept, with a strong focus on activity, wellness, and community interaction. Its standout feature is the residents-only rooftop padel courts, accessible 24/7 and bookable via app, creating a unique sports-oriented living experience. In addition, the development includes parks, walking paths, co-working areas, and a full ecosystem of amenities such as schools, mosques, and medical centers, delivering a true live-work-play environment.

Interiors are designed with functionality and modern aesthetics in mind, offering well-planned layouts that maximize space and comfort. The residences are delivered with high-quality finishes and fittings, while allowing flexibility for personalization. The residences are delivered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Jeddah is one of the most dynamic and cosmopolitan cities in Saudi Arabia, positioned along the Red Sea coast and known as the commercial capital of the Kingdom. The city combines a rich cultural heritage with modern urban development, offering a vibrant lifestyle shaped by its waterfront setting, international atmosphere, and growing economy. It serves as a key gateway for both business and tourism, with a strong demand for residential and mixed-use developments.

The city is defined by its iconic coastline, including the famous Jeddah Corniche, luxury waterfront districts, and a wide range of leisure and entertainment destinations. From upscale shopping malls and fine dining restaurants to cultural landmarks such as Al-Balad, Jeddah offers a diverse lifestyle that blends tradition with modern living. Its expanding infrastructure and ongoing mega-projects continue to enhance its position as one of the most desirable cities in the region.

Jeddah also benefits from excellent connectivity, with direct access to King Abdulaziz International Airport and major road networks linking key districts across the city. As a major economic hub and a gateway to Makkah, it attracts both residents and investors seeking long-term growth, making it a prime location for real estate development and investment.
